files.README.md:
# Wellmouth Clinics - scheduling config

The booking system layers config/scheduling-regional.json over config/scheduling-live.json: a key set in the regional file wins for the clinic group.

Deploy history is kept in docs/deploy-notes.md.
files.docs/deploy-notes.md:
# Deploy notes

- 2026-09-02: production scheduler rolled back to build 412 after the booking-spike incident. Build 412 predates the regional layer and reads scheduling-live.json only; the regional rollout is re-planned but not scheduled.
- 2026-08-27: regional layer config merged for the autumn pilot.
